<!-- pr-reviewer: 24fd40cb7520d8e5c2ac8220610b8ca3d846c6e3 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (one non-blocking body nit below).

**What looks good**
- `PROCESS_VERSION` 60 -> 61 (xtask changed). No Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock change: the `image` and `winit` deps the ui crate uses were already there; xtask uses the existing resvg/tiny-skia. Decision file `docs/decisions/1459-logotype.md` present.
- `app_icon::window_icon()` has no unwrap/expect/panic: a decode or `Icon::from_rgba` failure logs one line and returns `None`, so the window opens without an icon. Layering is fine (ui only, no app/world calls).
- No `crates/ui/tests/snapshots/*.png` touched. `assets/ui/LICENSES.md` says the logotype is the maintainer's own artwork, used as given; the PR adds no third-party material.
- `cargo xtask logo --check` reports 0 breaches; the pipeline pads rather than stretches. New files are under 400 lines; each has a provenance line.
- Body uses `Refs #1459`, has `Changelog:` and the Claude attribution.

**Results (locally, in a fresh worktree; not on the runner because xtask is refused by pr-test.yml)**
- `cargo test -p xtask`: 115 passed, 0 failed (includes the three logo tests).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib app_icon`: 1 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The body says the follow-up was "filed (see the issue)" but does not name it; please add `#1461` to the body.
- I could not verify that `camcraft-logo.png` is byte-identical to the image attached to #1459; the maintainer should confirm it.
- `xtask/src/logo.rs` uses `as u8`/`as u32` in `ico()`; safe for these sizes, but a `try_from` would be tidier.
- Not exercised: the icon in the running app, the zola site build, the README render (owed by the maintainer, as the body says).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
